presentation.title: Multi-tenant SaaS — Dimentionalizer
presentation.headline: Multi-tenant SaaS.
presentation.description: A shared application with explicit tenant context, identity, subscription billing, and asynchronous notifications. Illustrates shared infrastructure, not a complete tenant-isolation design.

objects.name: Tenant A workspace
objects.description: A browser session scoped to tenant A. Tenant isolation must be enforced by application and data access rules.

objects.name: Tenant B workspace
objects.description: A separate tenant session using the same application deployment.

objects.name: API entry point
objects.description: Routes requests to the application API and applies ingress limits.

objects.name: Tenant-aware API
objects.description: Validates identity and tenant membership before accessing tenant-scoped data.

objects.name: Identity provider
objects.description: Authenticates users and issues tokens. The API still authorizes access to tenant resources.

objects.name: Tenant-scoped database
objects.description: Shared relational store with tenant identifiers on relevant records. Isolation rules are part of the application design.

objects.name: Namespaced cache
objects.description: Uses tenant-scoped keys for cached results to avoid cross-tenant reuse.

objects.name: Tenant file storage
objects.description: Stores files under tenant-specific paths with access checks on every private operation.

objects.name: Work queue
objects.description: Carries jobs with explicit tenant context and idempotency identifiers.

objects.name: Tenant job worker
objects.description: Restores and verifies tenant context before running background work.

objects.name: Subscription provider
objects.description: External billing service receiving subscription changes and sending signed lifecycle callbacks.

objects.name: Notification service
objects.description: Sends invitations, billing updates, and account notifications.
